item.description:
McDonald’s 9 piece Chicken McNuggets® are made with 100% chicken breast meat in a deliciously crispy coating, just waiting to be dipped. A firm favourite with everyone.
Also available in 20 Chicken McNuggets® ShareBox® and 6 Piece Chicken McNuggets®.
Nutrition and allergen information do not include dips.

While there are no nuts or peanut ingredients in the products listed we can’t guarantee that our food is completely nut or peanut free.
